title: Ergoloid Mesylates
overview: This medication, a combination of several drugs that belong to a group of drugs called ergoloid mesylates, is used to relieve the signs and symptoms of decreased mental capacity due to the aging process.

sections.Before taking ergoloid mesylates,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to ergoloid mesylates, other ergot alkaloids (Cafergot, Ergostat, Bellergal), or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you have or have ever had a mental illness.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking ergoloid mesylates, call your doctor.
sections.Ergoloid mesylates may cause side effect: upset stomachvomitingloss of appetiteirritation under the tongue (with sublingual tablets)stuffy or runny noselightheadednessflushing (feeling of warmth)
sections.If you experience any of the following s: itchingrashblurred visiontrouble breathingIf you experience a serious side effect, you or your doctor may send a report to the Food and Drug Administration's (FDA) MedWatch Adverse Event Reporting program online (https://www.fda.gov/Safety/MedWatch) or by phone (1-800-332-1088).
